name: Bazzalan
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Bazzalan directs the Searing Blade cult's work in Ragefire Chasm. He shares its leadership with Jergosh the Invoker.

sections.title: A Serpent Beneath the City
sections.body: Bazzalan commands the Searing Blade's field forces in the lava caverns beneath Orgrimmar. While Thrall works to establish the Orcs' new home across Durotar, the satyr rogue moves through the winding caverns with twin blades, swift and lethal.

sections.title: Cult Leadership and Deceit
sections.body: From a volcanic ledge above the central chamber, Bazzalan watches over the cultist guards. Below him, Jergosh the Invoker conducts demonic rituals. Like all satyrs, Bazzalan's deepest loyalty belongs to demonic masters. He uses poison, quick strikes, and stealth against Horde scouts who venture near the cult's staging ground.

faq.answer: Bazzalan is a satyr rogue who shares leadership of the Searing Blade cult in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where can Bazzalan be found in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Bazzalan lurks on Ragefire Chasm's upper ledges, above Jergosh the Invoker. Dark ramps cut into the cavern walls lead up to him.

faq.q: What is a satyr doing beneath Orgrimmar?
aliases: why is there a satyr in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Bazzalan serves the Searing Blade, a demonic cult seeking to undermine the Horde from within. Satyrs are bound to demonic powers and often serve as instigators and assassins for shadow councils.

faq.q: What abilities does Bazzalan use in combat?
faq.answer: Bazzalan strikes swiftly with melee weapons and uses Sinister Strike. He sometimes afflicts opponents with a mild debilitating poison.

faq.q: What is his relationship to Jergosh the Invoker?
faq.answer: Bazzalan and Jergosh share leadership of the Searing Blade inside Ragefire Chasm. Jergosh handles invocations and summons dark forces, while Bazzalan commands the cult's martial and stealth work.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Bazzalan dead?
faq.answer: Bazzalan's presence deep beneath the capital threatens the Horde with demonic danger. Horde leaders send adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to eliminate him before the Searing Blade's plot endangers the city.

angles.text: Bazzalan and his cult threaten Thrall's stronghold from below, and the Horde wants them eliminated.
As a Rogue, you may take particular interest in Bazzalan's stealth, vicious strikes, and venom-coated blades.
As an Orc, you know how hard your people fought to escape demonic manipulation. A satyr directing cultists beneath their own city is an outrage.
